device.no_gateway: No ramses_esp gateway is connected. Check the gateway device in Homey.
device.no_remote: Set the address of a remote the unit is bound to (device settings) so Homey can control it.
device.invalid_remote: That is not a valid address. Use the form 29:123456.
device.invalid_address: That is not a valid address. Use the form 29:123456.

gateway.auth_failed: The MQTT broker refused the user name or password. Check the device settings.
gateway.offline: The ramses_esp reports that it is offline. Check its power and WiFi.

pair.no_gateway: Add your ramses_esp gateway first; Homey finds the other devices through it.

fan.title: Find the ventilation unit
fan.text: Homey lists the ventilation units the gateway has heard. Not listed? Press a button on the remote, wait a few seconds and continue: the unit answers and shows up. Searching takes up to 30 seconds. In an apartment building you may also see your neighbours' units: pick yours by its address (on the unit, or the FAN ID in your old Home Assistant config).

remote.title: Find the remote
remote.text: Press any button on the remote now, then continue. Searching takes up to 30 seconds.

sensor.title: Find the sensor
sensor.text: Sensors report every few minutes. Pressing the button on a sensor (if it has one) makes it report at once. Searching takes up to 30 seconds.

broker.title: Connect to the MQTT broker
broker.intro: The ramses_esp sends what it hears on 868 MHz to an MQTT broker. Enter the broker it uses; with the MQTT Broker app on Homey that is the address of your Homey.
broker.gateway_hint: Only needed when the gateway is not found automatically, e.g. 18:203612.
broker.invalid: Enter a valid broker address and port.
broker.not_reachable: No MQTT broker answered at this address. Check the address, port and that the broker is running.
broker.auth_failed: The broker refused the user name or password.
broker.no_gateways: Connected, but no ramses_esp published anything on this broker. Check the MQTT settings of the ramses_esp, or enter its address below.

settings.title: RAMSES bus
settings.no_gateways: No gateway added yet. Add a ramses_esp gateway as a device first.
settings.send_hint: Sent as is through the first connected gateway.
